native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Qbot-QakBot - Known Directory
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  event.category = 'Process'
  AND tgt.process.cmdline RegExp '
  (
    ?i
  )
  (
    :\\
    (
      datop|Busta|Watdan|Seng|Educ|Jhfrg|Oefstasti
    )
    [A-Za-z0-9\\]{0,20}\\[A-Za-z0-9]{1,20}\.
    (
      ocx|dll|exe|xex|ooccxx
    )
    $
  )
  '
  AND NOT
  (
    tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase ':\Education'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'DropBox'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Tool'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Educe'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Mgmt'
  )
)
OR
(
  event.category = 'File'
  AND tgt.file.path RegExp '
  (
    ?i
  )
  (
    :\\
    (
      datop|Busta|Watdan|Seng|Educ|Jhfrg|Oefstasti
    )
    [A-Za-z0-9\\]{0,20}\\[A-Za-z0-9]{1,20}\.
    (
      ocx|dll|exe|xex|ooccxx
    )
    $
  )
  '
  AND NOT
  (
    tgt.file.path contains:anycase ':\Education'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'DropBox'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Tool'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Educe'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Mgmt'
  )
)
